errors.text: The proposal conflates free-energy perturbation with windowed thermodynamic perturbation and Frenkel–Ladd calculations; these are not interchangeable, and the target efficiency gain specifically relies on direct MTP-to-DFT FEP with low energy-difference variance.
The falsification threshold is internally inconsistent: the hypothesis promises an error below 50 K but is only falsified above 100 K.

The cited evidence does not substantiate the quantitative claims of greater than 90% savings, 100-fold speedup, or the accuracy of MTP-based FEP. One citation concerns silver nanowire deformation and is materially irrelevant.
